poll: the data plane's aauth_pending watcher asks the auth service, which GETs https://ps.acme.example/ps/pending/0199… signed with the session key, honouring Retry-After, until 200 { auth_token } or 403
on_200: egress caches the auth token for this resource and session key
turn_posted_into_the_chat: [platform] The person's organisation approved the request that was awaiting approval. Retry that exact request now, then tell the person it went through.
